classification: Source contract inventory; not native qualification of every identity

identities.identity: Retained original Process + exact VM root/generation

identities.name: Account session

identities.name: Legacy endpoint
identities.identity: Opaque token + rights, endpoint ID and owner PID
identities.authority: SEND bearer; RECV and destroy additionally current task owner; Endpoint has no explicit generation

identities.name: Restricted channel
identities.authority: Per-role native channel authority; exclusive VM requirement preserved

identities.name: SHM backing
identities.identity: Broker token, frame vector and immutable process/session quota receipt
identities.authority: Backing persists across view ownership until legitimate final release

identities.name: Mapping
identities.identity: VM root/generation + base/extent + kind/backing; task mapped_shared tuple
identities.authority: Group VM ledger with task-local view cleanup ownership

identities.name: Retirement
identities.identity: Slot/generation, root/VM, exact VA/backing, shootdown sequence and target/received masks
identities.authority: Durable retirement obligation; quarantine prevents release/reuse

identities.name: Cleanup
identities.identity: Group receipt + per-task pending/pins + broker backing + retirement owner
identities.authority: Logical terminal publication distinct from physical task/group/resource reclamation
